transcript: Speaker A (AI): Where are you going? Speaker B (Driver): I go to home. Speaker A: You mean 'I am going home'. Speaker B: Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry. Speaker A: 'I am in a hurry' is the correct way to say that. Speaker B: Okay, thank you. અરે પણ તમે કોણ છો? [Hey, but who are you?] Speaker A: હું એક AI teacher છું. તમને English બોલવામાં help કરવા આવી છું. મારી સાથે daily બસ આ રીતે જ practice કરવાની છે. [I am an AI teacher. I'm here to help you speak English. You just need to practice daily with me like this.] Speaker B: મારી પાસે પૈસા તો નથી. [But I don't have money.] Speaker A: ચિંતા ના કરો. Trial version માટે અત્યારે ફક્ત એક જ રૂપિયો છે. જો ગમે તો 299 નું subscription લેવાનું છે. [Don't worry. The trial version is only one rupee right now. If you like it, you can get the 299 subscription.] Speaker B: સાચે જ? [Really?] Speaker A: હા, 1 Crore લોકો મારી સાથે English શીખી રહ્યા છે. તમે પણ join કરો. [Yes, 1 Crore people are learning English with me. You should join too.] Speaker B: હું અત્યારે જ download કરું છું. Thank you so much. [I am downloading it right now. Thank you so much.]

summary: An AI avatar corrects a driver's English grammar in real-time to demonstrate the MySivi app. The avatar explains its role as an AI tutor, highlighting a ₹1 trial offer and a large user base. The driver is convinced and downloads the app immediately.
